FINAL IVX DEEP QA — AUTONOMOUS SYSTEM + IVX IA CHAT END-TO-END

Execute this on the EXISTING IVX Holdings production project only.

Do not create a new app.
Do not create a new repository.
Do not create a second backend.
Do not create fake dashboards.
Do not report PASS without live evidence.
Do not stop after identifying issues.
Find, fix, deploy, retest, and prove every critical path.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVE

Complete a deep production QA of:

1. IVX Autonomous System
2. IVX IA Senior Developer
3. IVX IA Chat
4. Owner authentication and authorization
5. Worker job execution
6. GitHub commit workflow
7. Render deployment workflow
8. Supabase data and realtime
9. AWS storage and CloudFront
10. Expo React Native mobile app
11. Web app
12. Recovery, monitoring, and self-healing

The final result must prove that IVX can receive a real owner request, create a job, execute it, update code when authorized, deploy, verify production, report through IVX IA Chat, and preserve all evidence.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — FREEZE AND IDENTIFY PRODUCTION
==================================================

Before changing code, identify the exact production system.

Provide:

- GitHub repository
- branch
- current GitHub HEAD SHA
- Render service name
- Render service ID
- Render deployment ID
- live Render commit SHA
- Supabase project reference
- production API URL
- web URL
- owner chat URL
- Expo/EAS project ID
- Android build version
- iOS build version
- AWS region
- S3 bucket
- CloudFront distribution

Call:

GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health

The response must show:

- HTTP 200
- application version
- commit SHA
- build time
- boot time
- environment
- service name

Stop and correct any repository, branch, service, or commit mismatch before continuing.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — OWNER AUTHENTICATION QA
==================================================

Test on:

- Android physical device
- iOS physical device or verified build
- web browser
- restarted app
- restarted backend

Test every scenario:

1. Manual owner email/password login
2. Correct password accepted
3. Incorrect password rejected
4. Empty credentials rejected
5. Non-owner account rejected from owner routes
6. Owner session survives app restart
7. Logout clears the session
8. Login works again after logout
9. Expired token refreshes correctly
10. Revoked token is rejected
11. Owner Dashboard opens
12. Admin Hub opens
13. Variables module opens
14. Autonomous dashboard opens
15. IVX IA Chat opens
16. Protected APIs reject unauthenticated requests
17. Protected APIs return HTTP 200 with valid owner authentication
18. MFA is optional and controlled from Settings, not forced unexpectedly

Required evidence:

- timestamp
- platform
- test account role
- endpoint
- expected result
- actual result
- HTTP status
- traceId
- screenshot or log
- PASS/FAIL

==================================================
PHASE 3 — AUTONOMOUS SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE AUDIT
==================================================

Map the real autonomous execution flow from beginning to end:

Owner request
→ IVX IA Chat
→ task creation
→ approval validation
→ queue
→ worker pickup
→ execution
→ GitHub change
→ tests
→ deployment
→ live verification
→ final report
→ persistent audit record

Identify every real component:

- task table
- jobs table
- approvals table
- agent registry
- queue
- worker process
- scheduler
- cron jobs
- deployment service
- live verification service
- logging service
- alert service
- report service
- chat reporting integration

For each component provide:

- file or service name
- database table
- API route
- current status
- last successful execution
- failure handling
- retry behavior
- authentication method
- evidence source

Do not accept a UI card as proof that an autonomous component exists.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — REAL AUTONOMOUS JOB TESTS
==================================================

Create and execute real jobs in production-safe mode.

TEST A — READ-ONLY DIAGNOSTIC JOB

The autonomous system must:

1. Receive the owner request through IVX IA Chat.
2. Create a persistent task ID.
3. Create a worker job.
4. Save requester identity.
5. Save approval requirements.
6. Worker picks up the job.
7. Worker reads production health.
8. Worker audits GitHub, Render, Supabase, AWS, and AI providers.
9. Worker writes progress events.
10. IVX IA Chat displays progress.
11. Job reaches COMPLETED.
12. Final evidence remains after app restart.

TEST B — SAFE CODE CHANGE JOB

Execute a harmless, reversible production change, such as:

- add a diagnostic version field
- improve a safe log message
- add a non-user-facing health metadata field

The autonomous system must:

1. Request GITHUB_WRITE approval.
2. Confirm approval is valid.
3. Create a branch or use the approved production workflow.
4. Modify the correct file.
5. Run lint.
6. Run typecheck.
7. Run tests.
8. Commit.
9. Push to the owner repository.
10. Trigger Render deployment.
11. Wait for deployment.
12. Verify /health.
13. Confirm GitHub SHA equals live Render SHA.
14. Report completion through IVX IA Chat.

TEST C — FAILURE AND RECOVERY

Intentionally trigger a safe controlled failure:

- test failure
- rejected deployment
- invalid temporary endpoint
- expired approval

The autonomous system must:

1. Detect the failure.
2. Stop unsafe continuation.
3. Record the exact error.
4. Retry only when allowed.
5. Avoid infinite loops.
6. Notify the owner.
7. Preserve logs.
8. Recover after the issue is corrected.
9. Complete the task or mark it FAILED honestly.

==================================================
PHASE 5 — AUTONOMOUS SCHEDULER 24/7 QA
==================================================

Verify autonomous operation is not dependent on the owner keeping a screen open.

Test:

- scheduled job creation
- worker heartbeat
- worker restart recovery
- Render restart recovery
- missed-job recovery
- duplicate prevention
- retry limits
- dead-letter handling
- stale-lock cleanup
- job timeout
- approval expiration
- safe cancellation
- owner pause
- owner resume
- daily report
- two-hour progress report
- no-progress alert

Required behavior:

- Only one worker executes a job unless parallel execution is explicitly allowed.
- Restarting the worker does not lose the job.
- Restarting Render does not duplicate the job.
- Job state persists in Supabase.
- Chat history persists.
- The owner receives an honest status after recovery.
- Failed jobs do not appear as PASS.

==================================================
PHASE 6 — IVX IA CHAT DEEP QA
==================================================

Test IVX IA Chat on Android, iOS, and web.

MESSAGE RELIABILITY

1. Send one message.
2. Send ten messages quickly.
3. Send 100 messages in a controlled QA conversation.
4. Restart the app.
5. Restart Render.
6. Reopen the conversation.

Verify:

- no disappearing messages
- no duplicate messages
- no out-of-order messages
- stable persistent message IDs
- correct sender
- correct timestamps
- correct conversation ID
- last message restored
- unread status correct
- realtime updates correct
- pagination correct
- retry after network failure
- no duplicate send after retry

COMPOSER AND KEYBOARD

Verify:

- keyboard does not cover input
- send button remains visible
- multiline input works
- scrolling remains stable
- input draft is preserved appropriately
- attachment selector works
- screen does not jump
- Android back button works
- iOS safe area works
- web mobile browser works

ATTACHMENTS

Test:

- image
- multiple images
- video
- PDF
- document
- failed upload
- canceled upload
- network interruption
- app restart during upload

Verify:

- progress is real
- upload resumes or fails clearly
- attachment record persists
- preview works
- download/open works
- file ownership is enforced
- unauthorized users cannot access owner files
- no orphan files remain after failed upload

AI RESPONSE QUALITY

Verify that IVX IA Chat:

- reads the actual task state
- reads real provider results
- does not invent completed work
- distinguishes planned, running, failed, and completed
- returns job ID
- returns commit SHA when code changed
- returns deploy ID when deployed
- returns traceId for failures
- reports HTTP statuses
- never calls a narrative report proof

==================================================
PHASE 7 — CHAT TO AUTONOMOUS INTEGRATION
==================================================

Execute a real request from IVX IA Chat:

“Audit production health, execute a safe diagnostic job, and report the verified result.”

Prove:

1. Chat message saved.
2. Request classified correctly.
3. Owner authorization checked.
4. Task created.
5. Job created.
6. Worker accepted job.
7. Progress events written.
8. Progress visible in chat.
9. Final status written.
10. Evidence attached to the chat response.
11. Message and task remain linked after restart.

Every autonomous response in chat must show:

- task ID
- job ID
- current phase
- percentage based on real completed steps
- last action
- last timestamp
- next action
- blocker
- approval required
- final verdict

==================================================
PHASE 8 — APPROVAL AND SECURITY QA
==================================================

Verify approval scopes:

- READ_ONLY
- GITHUB_WRITE
- DEPLOY
- DATABASE_WRITE
- STORAGE_WRITE
- SECURITY_CHANGE

Test:

1. Read-only job cannot modify code.
2. GitHub approval cannot modify Supabase unless separately permitted.
3. Deploy approval cannot expose secrets.
4. Expired approval is rejected.
5. Reused approval is rejected when single-use.
6. Another user cannot use the owner's approval.
7. Approval is bound to task and action.
8. Approval actions are fully logged.
9. Secrets never appear in chat, logs, screenshots, or responses.
10. Owner can cancel an approval before execution.

Audit for:

- hardcoded secrets
- secret logging
- public owner routes
- insecure service-role usage
- missing row-level security
- weak JWT validation
- unprotected worker endpoints
- unauthenticated internal fetch calls
- cross-user conversation access
- public storage files that should be private

==================================================
PHASE 9 — DATABASE AND REALTIME QA
==================================================

Audit all autonomous and chat tables.

Verify:

- primary keys
- foreign keys
- unique constraints
- indexes
- created_at
- updated_at
- status enums
- owner_id
- task_id
- job_id
- conversation_id
- message_id
- trace_id
- retry_count
- error field
- evidence field

Test:

- duplicate insert prevention
- transaction rollback
- concurrent updates
- lost connection recovery
- realtime reconnect
- data after Render restart
- data after mobile restart
- row-level security
- owner-only access
- non-owner denial

No fake or seed task should be displayed as a production job.

==================================================
PHASE 10 — GITHUB EXECUTION QA
==================================================

Verify:

- correct repository
- correct branch
- correct owner account
- valid token binding
- read access
- write access only with approval
- branch protection compliance
- clean working tree before change
- diff review
- commit creation
- push
- commit retrieval
- conflict handling
- rollback strategy

For every autonomous code job, provide:

- repository
- branch
- parent SHA
- new SHA
- files changed
- tests run
- push status
- comparison URL or commit reference
- approval ID
- actor

No code may remain only inside a temporary Rork environment.

==================================================
PHASE 11 — RENDER DEPLOYMENT QA
==================================================

Verify:

- correct Render service
- correct repository binding
- correct branch
- automatic deployment settings
- environment variables
- build command
- start command
- health check
- worker service
- API service
- deployment logs
- rollback

Run:

1. Trigger a controlled deployment.
2. Capture deployment ID.
3. Confirm build starts.
4. Confirm build passes.
5. Confirm new container boots.
6. Confirm health returns HTTP 200.
7. Confirm live SHA.
8. Confirm worker heartbeat.
9. Confirm IVX IA Chat remains operational.
10. Confirm no old container continues serving stale code.

==================================================
PHASE 12 — PROVIDER VERIFICATION
==================================================

Retest live:

- GitHub
- Render
- Supabase
- AWS STS
- S3
- CloudFront
- AI provider
- JWT/security
- email provider if configured
- SMS provider if configured
- Expo/EAS if used by autonomous jobs

For each provider return:

- operation tested
- timestamp
- result
- HTTP status
- latency
- traceId
- masked identity
- PASS/FAIL

The final provider matrix must use real calls, not variable-presence checks.

==================================================
PHASE 13 — MOBILE AND WEB STABILITY
==================================================

Test:

- cold launch
- warm launch
- background/foreground
- airplane mode
- slow connection
- Wi-Fi to cellular switch
- app restart
- backend restart
- expired session
- low-memory recovery
- 30-minute chat session
- 2-hour autonomous monitoring session

Verify:

- no crash
- no white screen
- no permanent spinner
- no lost messages
- no repeated jobs
- no frozen progress
- no incorrect PASS
- no owner-session loss without reason

==================================================
PHASE 14 — OBSERVABILITY AND OWNER DASHBOARD
==================================================

The Autonomous Dashboard must show real data only.

Required sections:

1. Active jobs
2. Queued jobs
3. Waiting for approval
4. Running jobs
5. Live verification
6. Completed jobs
7. Failed jobs
8. Canceled jobs
9. Worker status
10. Provider status
11. Deployment history
12. GitHub commits
13. Error logs
14. Retry history
15. Owner approvals
16. Two-hour reports
17. Daily executive report

Each job must show:

- job ID
- task ID
- agent
- request
- start time
- duration
- current phase
- progress
- commit SHA
- deployment ID
- traceId
- evidence
- final result

Do not show static demonstration data.

==================================================
PHASE 15 — SELF-HEALING TEST
==================================================

Test controlled recovery for:

- worker crash
- queue interruption
- Render restart
- Supabase temporary failure
- AI provider timeout
- GitHub timeout
- deployment failure
- AWS failure
- chat realtime disconnect

Required behavior:

- detect failure
- record exact cause
- retry with limits
- back off safely
- avoid duplication
- notify owner
- preserve task state
- resume correctly
- report unresolved blocker honestly

Self-healing must never silently change credentials, security settings, payment data, or production data without owner approval.

==================================================
PHASE 16 — FINAL END-TO-END ACCEPTANCE TEST
==================================================

Execute this final production-safe owner request through IVX IA Chat:

“Run a full production health audit, fix one approved safe defect, commit it to my GitHub repository, deploy it to the existing Render service, verify the live commit, and return the evidence here.”

Required final flow:

1. Owner message saved.
2. Task created.
3. Approval requested.
4. Approval accepted.
5. Worker picked up task.
6. Code inspected.
7. Safe defect fixed.
8. Tests passed.
9. Commit pushed.
10. Render deployment triggered.
11. Deployment completed.
12. /health returned HTTP 200.
13. GitHub SHA matched Render SHA.
14. Providers passed.
15. Final message returned in IVX IA Chat.
16. Evidence remained after app and backend restart.

==================================================
FINAL REQUIRED REPORT
==================================================

Return one report with:

A. PRODUCTION IDENTITY
- repository
- branch
- GitHub HEAD
- Render live SHA
- Render service
- deployment ID
- API version
- boot time

B. AUTONOMOUS STATUS
- scheduler status
- queue status
- worker status
- heartbeat
- last successful job
- recovery test
- duplicate prevention
- approval enforcement

C. IVX IA CHAT STATUS
- Android
- iOS
- web
- persistence
- realtime
- attachments
- keyboard
- ordering
- duplicates
- task linkage

D. FINAL JOB EVIDENCE
- owner request
- task ID
- job ID
- approval ID
- commit SHA
- deployment ID
- health result
- traceId
- start time
- finish time
- final state

E. PROVIDER MATRIX
- GitHub
- Render
- Supabase
- AWS
- S3
- CloudFront
- AI
- Security
- Expo/EAS
- email/SMS when configured

F. DEFECT REGISTER
For every discovered issue provide:
- issue ID
- severity
- root cause
- file or service
- fix
- commit SHA
- deployment ID
- retest result
- final status

==================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
==================================================

Do not mark complete until all are true:

- Owner authentication passes on Android, iOS, and web.
- Autonomous jobs persist through restarts.
- Worker executes without the owner keeping the app open.
- No duplicate jobs.
- No lost jobs.
- No fake progress.
- No fake PASS.
- Approval scopes are enforced.
- IVX IA Chat preserves message IDs and order.
- IVX IA Chat shows real autonomous progress.
- Safe code change is committed to the owner's GitHub.
- Render deploys the exact commit.
- GitHub SHA equals Render live SHA.
- /health returns HTTP 200.
- Provider tests use real live operations.
- Failures show exact errors and trace IDs.
- Recovery and retry behavior is proven.
- The final owner request completes end-to-end.
- All evidence is visible inside IVX IA Chat.
- Final status is VERIFIED PASS, not narrative PASS.

Execute every phase one by one.

Fix failures immediately, deploy the fixes, and repeat the failed tests.

Return progress every two hours through IVX IA Chat until the entire end-to-end acceptance test is VERIFIED PASS.
